entries.sense_en: staring with the mouth open in surprise

synonyms.nuance: Informal; stare stupidly, often rude.
Look for a long time; the mouth need not be open.
Stare with wide eyes, in wonder.
synonyms.example: The kids goggled at the cake.

entries.tip_ko: 보통 gape at ~ 형태로 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: to destroy a whole area completely

synonyms.nuance: Cause huge damage; also used for storms and feelings.
Damage badly over a wide area, often by war or disease.
Informal; ruin something.

entries.tip_ko: 'lay waste to ~'로 쓰기도 합니다.

entries.sense_en: to hate something and find it disgusting

synonyms.nuance: Common and strong; not always disgust.
Formal, strong dislike.
Very strong; moral horror.

entries.tip_ko: loathe는 끝이 [ð], 형용사 loath는 [θ]입니다.

entries.sense_en: broke up and went away in different directions

synonyms.nuance: Go in many directions suddenly, often in fear.
Casual; a group ends and leaves.
Move apart but still stay in an area.

entries.tip_ko: 강세는 두 번째 음절(perse)에 있습니다.

entries.sense_en: pigs; here used as an insult for people who live dirtily
entries.sense_ko: 돼지(여기서는 지저분하게 사는 사람을 욕하는 말)

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for the animal; insult for greedy or dirty people.
Mainly American; a big pig, or a greedy person.
A cruel, rough person; not about dirt.

entries.tip_ko: 복수형도 swine입니다(swines가 아님).

entries.sense_en: to weave hair into a braid

synonyms.nuance: American word for the same; plait is more British.
Cross threads or strips over and under, as in cloth or baskets.
Turn strands round each other, no weaving of three.

entries.tip_ko: 영국식은 [plæt]이고, 미국에서는 [pleɪt]로도 읽습니다.

entries.sense_en: to pay attention to what someone says and follow it

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; hear with attention, but not necessarily obey.
Do what you are told.
Informal; pay attention to and follow a warning.

entries.modern: "did not heed him" → "did not listen to him"
entries.tip_ko: 'heed a warning'처럼 경고·충고와 자주 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: with goods or services, not with money

synonyms.nuance: The system of trading goods directly.
Plain description; less fixed than 'in kind'.
Just says a trade; no idea that money is avoided.

entries.tip_ko: 'repay in kind'는 '같은 방식으로 되갚다'라는 다른 뜻도 있습니다.

entries.sense_en: hard and rough, like horn, from a lot of hard work

synonyms.nuance: The usual modern word for hands hardened by work.
General; not smooth, without saying why.
Made tough, by work or by life.

entries.tip_ko: 현대 영어에서 horny는 주로 성적인 뜻으로 쓰이니, 이 뜻으로는 쓰지 마세요.

entries.sense_en: lazy people who avoid work

synonyms.nuance: Someone who wastes time doing nothing; milder.
Informal; avoids effort at work or school.
British; a lazy person with no job.

entries.sense_en: the scraps of food that are left over

synonyms.nuance: Modern and neutral; food kept for a later meal.
Small bits left over, often given to animals.
Formal; what is left of anything.

entries.tip_ko: 보통 복수형으로 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: talking fast and foolishly, without making sense

synonyms.nuance: Talk quickly and unclearly, like a baby or a stream.
Talk fast about small matters; friendly.
Talk angrily at length.

entries.sense_en: walking unsteadily as if about to fall

synonyms.nuance: Trip over something; a quick single loss of balance.
Weak steps, as if the body or a tower may fall.
Sway back and forth, as from a blow or drink.

entries.tip_ko: staggering은 '깜짝 놀랄 만큼 큰'이라는 형용사로도 자주 쓰입니다.
